answers.text: Quote: 'extension, not a test, pullback or contraction.' My test is C5: established trend, normal pullback, then a new high. W HH/HL, D HH/HL, D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.46: it is AT its high, not chasing far above it. A pullback to buy is what C5 forbids me to wait for. The H1 LL (swing low 24.07) is a minor swing my formula filters (C21). Extension is late-leg risk I already named (C15); my answer to it is the one-atr danger signal (C7), not a refusal.

Quote: 'W swing LH/LL leaves the first screen unclean.' elder_5d is advisory, not my field. The weekly swing label lags price: W close_vs_swing_high_pct 29.71 and dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.8, so the weekly is at a new 20-week high above its last swing high, the C5 new high. I grant W LH/LL means the uptrend is young, not old (C5a partial), and D close_vs_swing_high_pct 30.04 is late-leg; my answer is the one-atr danger signal (C7).

Quote: 'test of the prior low gives the lowest-risk entry.' That is buying the reaction, which C5 forbids. D LH/LL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.88, W dist_to_20bar_high_pct 13.34: no new high on either frame, and a BEARISH_CHOCH is a character change, not a normal pullback. H1 92.3% of range is a minor swing (C21). Low risk is not my test; a new high is. I stay opposed until a close above pivot_high.
